comments.story: McClure steps back at 500Startups after internal sexual misconduct investigation
comments.text: Yeah, it's not fine. I meant it in a different way (and was being somewhat sarcastic): that in a lot of cases, office flirting (even among equal peers) can seem OK if the woman likes the guy, and creepy if they don't (e.g. he is awkward, nerdy, out of shape, etc). In essence, a comment on how "jocks" get away with more of that kind of stuff. [VIDEO]
